_comment: The shape of ~/Library/Application Support/CloudMachine/machines.json, which CloudMachine creates itself. Only limit_gb is used: set it with `cloudmachine-agent set-limit --gb N` or the Space limit card, which store it under this Mac's Drive folder name. Keep the sum of limit_gb of all Macs on one Google account below its real capacity, with a safety margin.
_bwlimit_comment: Read but not used: the upload from the machine has no rclone --bwlimit; incoming SMB is shaped inside the machine (vm/smb-throttle.sh). drive_total_gb, safety_margin_percent, remote_name and remote_root_folder are likewise read and not used (the Drive remote and root folder are fixed in code: gdrive:CloudMachine).
